issues.description: `begin_turn/4` no longer accepts `:continue`, so the continue path used to resume an interrupted session raises a FunctionClauseError instead of appending `turn.started`.

Tool calls held as plain maps are only looked up by string key, so the `:id`/`:name` maps that durable history is decoded into are dropped as invalid and unresolved tool calls are never reported for a resumed session.
